The '''Illoud system''' was [[Star system/Legends|system]] in [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-backed [[Illoud system insurgency|uprising]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], sometime between the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]] and the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. [[Huoba Neva]] helped put down the uprising, for which she was given command of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Rebel Star]]''.
